CYCLE09: EXACT STATIONARITY REPAIR OF ONE RAW BROADCASTER
Independent theorem-first baseline. Owner variance_monogamy_sol; no descendants.
All previous proof/report/index/manifest bytes remain immutable.
No sibling Cycle09 proof has been read. The sole authorized new scope input is
tensor_frame_sol/cycle08_general_canonical_consequences/
SCOPE_CLOSURE_AND_NEXT_GATE.txt, read for the precise fixed-margin raw gate.

STATUS
The stationarity-repair target is CLOSED by an explicit common local output
channel and a proved reference-uniform gentle bound. No mutual-information
budget is needed for this repair step. Exact KMS/Petz symmetrization and the
final raw-to-canonical power are separate gates and are not asserted here.
No external, formal, historical novelty, or priority validation is claimed.

1. EXACT THEOREM AND SUPPLIED TARGET

Let B be any finite-dimensional local system, sigma>0 a fixed faithful density,
and Braw:B->B1 tensor B2 ONE full-domain CPTP broadcaster, with B1,B2 identified
with B. Let E be any nonempty family of joint states rho_RB, with arbitrary
finite untouched references, such that every local marginal is rho_B=sigma.
Suppose for this ONE broadcaster, on the WHOLE family,

 max_j T[(id_R tensor Braw_j)(rho_RB),rho_RB] <= b,  0<=b<=1,

where T=half the trace norm. The family may be infinite and its reference
dimensions may vary. No rank/faithfulness condition is required for the tested
rho_RB, and no mutual-information assumption is used.

Then there is ONE full-domain CPTP broadcaster Bfix, constructed from Braw and
sigma ONLY, whose two marginals equal a channel Phi_fix satisfying

 Phi_fix(sigma)=sigma,
 sup_{rho in E} T[(id_R tensor Phi_fix)(rho),rho]
     <= min{1, b+sqrt(delta)+delta/2}
     <= min{1, sqrt(b)+(3/2)b}
     <= min{1, (5/2)sqrt(b)},

where delta=T(Phi(sigma),sigma)<=b and Phi=(Braw_1+Braw_2)/2. Thus Phi_fix is
exactly sigma stationary and self-compatible. There is no inverse minimum-
eigenvalue factor, dimension factor, state-dependent local channel, or
reference dependence. This theorem does NOT assert KMS symmetry of Phi_fix.

The task supplied only the exact fixed-margin repair target and the old gate
scope. The dominating-operator filter, channel completion, and quantitative
reference bound below were derived independently here. No new source or
sibling proof was needed for these finite-matrix calculations.

2. FIRS

CYCLE09 EXPOSED BINARY PETZ ENDPOINT AUDIT AND FINAL HANDOFF

Status: PASS for the supplied fixed-qubit lower witness. Combined with the
unchanged independent binary-CQ upper bound, the universal residual exponent
1/2 is sharp on the binary-CQ subclass. The arbitrary mixed quantum-reference
Umegaki-budget gate remains UNKNOWN.

Written after authorized exposure. This is a new addendum; the independent
baseline, its status, its manifest, and every older frozen file are unchanged.

1. Provenance and exact exposure boundary.

The independent baseline was frozen at 2026-10-09 00:21:01 UTC:
  work/agents/variance_monogamy_sol/cycle09_quantum_petz/INDEPENDENT_BASELINE.txt
  SHA256 7a47339269b578de9ea8b4280a2e0c55650a9e65918a5a4bee9826d8a47e6ec9.

The coordinator authorized the following post-freeze mathematical exposure:
  work/agents/tensor_frame_sol/cycle09_petz_symmetrization/
    FIXED_QUBIT_STATIONARY_MARGIN_OBSTRUCTION.txt
  SHA256 efaa678dcd894f73ff8a4fadfe3ccf7733c520d1483039e2692da8e69575445e.
Its hash was checked before reading. First-read receipt:
2026-10-09 00:21:18 UTC. Its channel, tested states, and coefficients are the
originator's construction. This audit does not claim their rediscovery.

The coordinator subsequently authorized a source-only memo:
  work/agents/broadcast_literature_luna/cycle09_pretty_good_reverse/REPORT.txt
  SHA256 f472f53056a751aff28523e3a5407d0fb871fb402aae090bab3e95e169f6edf6.
Post-freeze read receipt: 2026-10-09 00:23:03 UTC.
The precise Barnum-Knill singleton antecedent is recorded in Section 7 below.

This audit uses exact algebra. No additional numerical diagnostic, optimizer,
state scan, descendant, source-file edit, or source catalogue was performed.
Neither formal verification, external validation, nor historical priority is
asserted.

2. Interface and the already independent upper endpoint.

Throughout T(rho,eta)=||rho-eta||_1/2. All channels act on the full matrix
algebra. Sigma is a faithful stationary density matrix and
  PhiSharp = Gamma_sigma Phi* Gamma_sigma^{-1},
  Gamma_sigma(X)=sqrt(sigma) X sqrt(sigma),
  S=PhiSharp Phi.
Phi is CPTP but is not assumed KMS symmetric. The same S is used for every
tested state; it depends only on Phi and sigma.

The frozen independent proof gives, for every Hermitian X with
-sigma<=X<=sigma,
  ||X-SX||_1^2 <= 2 ||X-Phi X||_1.                          (1)
